categories.main_business_segments: Under Armour operates primarily in four geographic segments: North America, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The company’s principal business activities are the development, marketing, and distribution of branded performance apparel, footwear, and accessories for men, women, and youth. These segments all focus on the same core industry of performance athletic products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Under Armour’s products are engineered with proprietary technologies such as HEATGEAR®, COLDGEAR®, HOVR®, UA Flow™, and Charged Cushioning®. The company focuses on technical fabrications and advanced materials, with most manufacturing outsourced to unaffiliated contract manufacturers. Product development emphasizes performance, comfort, and fit, leveraging athlete feedback and internal innovation teams.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of customers including national, regional, independent, and specialty wholesalers and distributors, as well as direct consumers through its own retail stores and e-commerce platforms. Key end markets include athletes at all levels, sports teams, and consumers with active lifestyles, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of net revenues.
categories.geographic_coverage: Under Armour has a global footprint, with North America (primarily the U.S. and Canada) accounting for 61% of net revenues in FY2024, and EMEA, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America collectively representing 38%. The company operates retail stores and e-commerce in major markets worldwide and utilizes third-party logistics providers for distribution in several regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Under Armour is positioned downstream in the supply chain, focusing on product design, branding, marketing, and distribution. Manufacturing is outsourced to third-party contract manufacturers, with the company overseeing quality, sourcing, and compliance but not directly owning production facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include driving growth in wholesale, footwear, women’s, and direct-to-consumer businesses, as well as expanding digital engagement and loyalty programs. The company emphasizes sustainable innovation, circular design, and materials innovation, with ongoing investments in digital platforms and supply chain efficiency. Recent restructuring aims to rebalance costs and improve profitability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of apparel, footwear, and accessories via wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels (including owned stores and e-commerce). Additional revenue streams include licensing arrangements and digital subscriptions/advertising, though these are a small portion of total revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Under Armour competes in a highly competitive market against major global brands such as Nike, adidas, PUMA, and lululemon, as well as regional and private label brands. The company positions itself as a premium performance brand focused on innovation and athletic authenticity, but faces challenges from larger competitors with greater resources and broader distribution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2024, Under Armour reported net revenues of $5.7 billion, a 3.4% decrease from the prior year, with net income of $232 million. The company experienced growth in EMEA, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America, but faced declines in North America and overall operating income. The business is mature and currently experiencing modest or negative growth, with ongoing restructuring to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Under Armour’s value proposition centers on making athletes better through innovative, high-performance products that offer superior comfort, fit, and technical benefits. The brand emphasizes authenticity, athlete endorsement, and a focus on performance-driven design, differentiating itself through proprietary technologies and a commitment to sustainability and inclusivity.
